body:
**The request (mkinney, 2026-11-15):** "Should probably have a first cut on a lathe". This is the lathe counterpart of #1905 (plasma) and #1904 (first 4-axis part). Mill first-run is `first-run.md`.

## What

A "Your first lathe part" page: one complete, small, verified turning job on a Tormach 8L (`assets/machines/` 8L file, post `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps`).

## Content

1. **The part:** a short turned pin with a face, an OD turn with a shoulder, a chamfer, a center-drilled or drilled end, and an external thread. All of it is in a committed demo project.
2. **Set up:** a turning setup, bar stock (diameter, stick-out), the chuck (a generated 3-jaw chuck, #1442), the work offset (Z0 on the finished face; X is the spindle centreline, diameter mode).
3. **Tools:** a turning insert, a drill, and a threading insert. The tool numbers and offsets (T0101 style), the insert nose radius, and how the tool table in PathPilot must match.
4. **Operations, in order:** Face, OD rough and finish, drill, thread (G76: the passes, the depth, what J, K and R mean; link the G76 notes from #1619 and #1705). CSS (G96) with a max rpm, and why.
5. **Check:** the simulation (the turned stock), the holder-to-jaw collision check, and the refusals turning has.
6. **Post and prove it:** post for the 8L, then a dry run in the **PathPilot Hub 8L simulator**. The setup notes from the 2026-11-14 Hub runs:
   - If the load warns "exceeds machine maximum on Z", type a larger value in the Z DRO. That moves G54 Z toward the chuck and gives headroom.
   - The "Change tool to T1" prompt needs Cycle Start. Or set the tool changer to Gang in Settings so T-words only load offsets.
   - The tool moves one axis at a time around G30 (#1667).

   Check: no alarm, each tool change, the G76 passes, M30. Record the cycle time and last line.
7. **On the real machine:** a first-cut checklist (stick-out against the chuck, tool height on centre, the guard, chip control) in short points, linked to Tormach's public docs.

## Rules

- Clean room: CamCraft renders and our own text only. Tormach's public docs may be cited and linked, not copied. Nothing from HSMWorks or Fusion.
- Images from the reproducible renders (#1902) once they exist.

## Done means

- The page is on the site, linked from Getting started (#1903), `first-run.md` and `operations-turning.md`.
- The demo project posts with no refusal and runs to M30 in the Hub 8L simulator (the run is recorded on this issue).
- `zola build` passes.
